clock_semantics.workers_wall_seconds: Measured combined worker phase, serial or concurrent; includes post-agent review and focused checks.
clock_semantics.worker_wall_seconds: Measured individual worker total including prompt setup, agent call, review and focused check.
clock_semantics.agent_seconds: Measured client invocation duration; does not include preparation or coordinator grading.
clock_semantics.coordinator_check_seconds: Each recorded trusted fast/integration/acceptance command duration, kept separate.
clock_semantics.coordinator_residual_seconds: Derived total minus preparation minus worker phase; includes copying, coordinator checks and overhead, not a directly measured integration phase.
clock_semantics.total_wall_seconds: Measured scenario duration including preparation and all completed phases, including failures.

interpretation: Only final result manifests enter completed counts; active logs are not hashed as final evidence.
Two repetitions per client/mode; retain failures and do not select only successful or fastest scenarios.
Fixture commits can differ by timestamp; compare fixture_tree for prepared source equality.
Prompt hashes retain per-worktree scratch/cache guidance; equal task family does not imply identical raw prompt text.
No comparative statistic or speedup is claimed before all scenarios and independent reviews finish.
